claims.evidence: Singh et al. FAO case study p. 64 describes FR13A pure-line selection from Dhalaputia and its early-1950s release; Jackson and Ram give an earlier 1940s release account; genebank passport IRGC 117267 records Dhalputtia ancestry and accession acquisition on 1 October 2006 only. By-1959 bound and unresolved discrepancy retain uncertainty.

Mackill et al. 1993 pp. 749–752, tables 1–3 identify the FR13A ancestry via IR26702 and 1990–91 IRRI testing of line -2; Xu et al. 2006 p. 707 Fig. 3 independently identifies IR49830 as FR13A-derived. Established builds_on is a family-level material ancestry, not proof of separate line identity.

Xu et al. 2006 p. 707 reports the Swarna-Sub1 lines and donor. Septiningsih et al. 2009 Table 1 distinguishes IR05F101 and IR05F102; methods identify donor suffix -2, against Xu, CRRI 2009 p. 3 and Reddy 2013 Table 4 suffix -3. Final link correctly confines the established ancestry to IR49830 family and records conflict. Reddy Table 4 and release paragraph identify IR82809-237 as 2007 trial and released line. CRRI newsletter p. 3 separately reports 20 April state release and 26 June central approval. Dar 2013 abstract and methods reports randomized 2011 farm trial, not adoption. Raghu 2022 §3.2 and §5.1.1 establishes sampled 2015 cultivation only. UPSCALE 4 September 2026 operator table and measures document project deployment, with no harvest or variety-specific survival claim.

Sandhu et al. 2019 Methods identifies IR05F102 recurrent background, and Results/Fig. 3 identifies the line and 2015–16 Indian national trials. Septiningsih Table 1 independently ties IR05F102 to IR82810-407, distinct from released IR05F101; ICAR cultivar compendium p. 42 confirms Swarna-Sub1 parentage. Gazette S.O. 1498(E), issue 2 April 2019 pp. 1 and 9–10, is notification effective on publication and is not proof of sales. Meher et al. 2024 §2.1 and abstract report a 2023 Kalahandi farmer-field project trial, not ordinary uptake.

Inventory in-service status is supported for sampled 2015 cultivation and separately bounded 2026 project footprint; CR Dhan 801 and Hasanta are demonstration statuses, without attribution of adoption. Trace, alternate and frontier reflect the material ancestry and donor suffix dispute; no counterfactual lineage or priority asserted.

Checked original papers, breeder institutional newsletter, Gazette, operator update, and the genebank passport against referenced passages. Reddy trial table and release paragraph were read from the originating EIRLSBN volume; descriptor records excerpt mapping and hash. Source passage locators now identify the supporting text.

corrections: Replaced single-character evidence locators with usable passages; corrected Sandhu author order, Septiningsih author names and online date; corrected newsletter page and source access; narrowed donor relation to family level and recorded -2 versus -3 conflict; corrected Meher source link.
deferred: FR13A original station selection and release papers and first IRRI acquisition; exact IR49830 donor suffix; CR Dhan 801 2017 release decision distinct from 2019 notification; current representative cultivar uptake and post-flood results.
